trial_court: Court of the learned Civil Judge (Senior Division), Banki, C.P. No.7 of 2019
facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife filed a petition under Section 24 of the C.P.C. praying for transfer of C.P. No.7 of 2019 to the Court of the learned Civil Judge (Senior Division), Athagarh.

legal_principles.principle: Directions are usually issued for mitigating the inconvenience faced by an opposite party in a proceeding under Section-9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, instead of transferring the proceeding.
legal_principles.held: But in the present case as it is stated that MAT Case No. 150 of 2019 in the Court of the learned Civil Judge (Senior Judge), Athagarh filed under Section 18(1), 2(b) of the Hindu Adoption and Maintenance Act, 1956 by the petitioner-wife is pending.
applicable_acts_sections: Hindu Adoption and Maintenance Act — Section 18(1), 2(b)

legal_principles.principle: In the interest of justice, it is expedient to transfer a proceeding pending in one court to another court.
legal_principles.held: it would be expedient in the interest of justice to transfer of C.P. No.7 of 2019 pending in the Court of the learned Senior Civil Judge, Banki, to the Court of the learned Senior Civil Judge, Athagarh.

outcome.final_order: C.P. No.7 of 2019 is transferred to the Court of the learned Senior Civil Judge, Athagarh.
